channel.title: PostPush updates
channel.description: Release updates for the self-hosted MQTT-to-AirPlay mailbox announcement bridge.

item.title: PostPush 0.2.15
item.description: Version 0.2.15 adds an English and German switch to the local web interface.

item.title: PostPush 0.2.14
item.description: Version 0.2.14 surrounds announcements with silence so short sounds are no longer cut off before HomePods start playing.

item.title: PostPush 0.2.13
item.description: Version 0.2.13 restores balanced hero proportions and renders the GitHub artwork with the real PostPush logo.

item.title: PostPush 0.2.12
item.description: Version 0.2.12 translates the complete local interface to English, removes the remaining white logo matte, and adds a dedicated social share image.

item.title: PostPush 0.2.11
item.description: Version 0.2.11 removes the white matte around the PostPush icon in Runtipi.

item.title: PostPush 0.2.10
item.description: Version 0.2.10 applies the new PostPush app icon consistently across the web app, public website, GitHub presentation, favicons, and Runtipi packages.

item.title: PostPush 0.2.9
item.description: Version 0.2.9 adds the public project website, an illustrated English README, English Runtipi metadata, and direct project-support links.

item.title: PostPush 0.2.8
item.description: Version 0.2.8 retries inactive AirPlay outputs through OwnTone's receiver toggle endpoint.

item.title: PostPush 0.2.7
item.description: Version 0.2.7 verifies HomePod activation before starting an announcement.

item.title: PostPush 0.2.6
item.description: Version 0.2.6 fixes OwnTone output-volume updates for selected AirPlay speakers.

item.title: PostPush 0.2.5
item.description: Version 0.2.5 introduces the polished mailbox-and-HomePod web interface.

item.title: PostPush 0.2.0
item.description: Version 0.2.0 adds uploaded audio announcements alongside local Piper text-to-speech.
